sensitivity.note: Same base model with the Elo leg switched off (w=1). Shown for transparency; the published base uses the pre-registered weight.

tally_rule: The public tally counts `adjusted` (the headline). `base` is the backtested model and is scored alongside it. v1 only: later versions are shown but never swapped in.

sanity.note: Our Elo runs on a closed pool from 1500 (3 seasons), so only differences are comparable. Display only: no model value was changed after the lock.
